analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (219,500 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (230,300/264,350/300,020 KRW) — indicating short-term and mid-term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 (257,043/192,040 KRW) — mixed mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (49.5%) + current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.4→37.3) — entering oversold, downward momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3197.6937→-5121.4836) — worsening, bearish trend strengthening.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (Lower Band 208,666 KRW) — approaching the lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (167,300 KRW) — based on Pivot S1.
· Swing resistance (223,000 KRW) — resistance based on 5-day high.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High) — confirming downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.73x) — contracted volume, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Distribution phase) — maintain observation, consider buying if resistance at 223,000 KRW is broken.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 고가가 20일 고가보다 낮아 Lower High 패턴이 확인되었으며, 이는 하락 추세의 지속 가능성을 시사한다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The 5-day high being lower than the 20-day high confirms a Lower High pattern, suggesting the potential for a continued downtrend.
keyPoints: RSI 과매도 진입 및 MACD 약세 수렴 유지로 매수 관점 전환은 아직 이르다.
Lower High 패턴 확인으로 추가 하락 가능성을 염두에 두어야 한다.
거래량 비율 0.73으로 현재 가격 움직임의 신뢰도가 낮다.
keyPointsEn: RSI entering oversold and MACD maintaining bearish convergence indicate it's too early to shift to a buy stance.
The confirmed Lower High pattern suggests considering the possibility of further downside.
The volume ratio of 0.73 indicates low confidence in the current price movement.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 28.3로 추세가 형성되는 초기 단계이므로, 현재의 하락이 추세적 붕괴인지 단순 되돌림인지 판단하기 어렵다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 28.3, the trend is in its early stages, making it difficult to determine if the current decline is a structural breakdown or a simple retracement.
